description: Open and flowing. Well-lit throughout. Deep — views through multiple spaces. No internal corridor — fully open layout. Kitchen: unclear, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: split seating-kitchen-dining, kitchen on side wall. Seating: An L-shaped sofa sits in the lower-right corner facing toward the centre and the wall-mounted TV area; the double bed occupies the upper-right corner.. Dining table (4 seats). TV on wall opposite wall to entry. Cook can see TV from cooking position. Diners do not face the TV. Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is kitchen, straight corridor, short. Entry area has space for coat and shoe storage. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Studio apartment. Double bed. Bed visible from front door, visible from kitchen. Fully open plan — cooking smells and sounds reach the sleeping area directly. Storage: one wardrobe. One bathroom (shower, bathtub, and toilet). Single bathroom — all household members share one shower, sequential morning routine. Suits: singles or couples comfortable with combined living and sleeping space. Not suitable for: families with children (single open studio, no separate bedrooms); roommates or flatshares (no private sleeping rooms or doors); anyone needing a dedicated home office (no desk or separate work room); those wanting privacy between sleeping and living areas (bed fully exposed in open plan).
